title: Ringing the Bell

placements.sceneDescription: Inside the weathered Japanese island house during the sudden rain, Riku, Chika and Mori gather on the small part of the floor that remains. Wind slips through gaps in the boards; Riku sits in wet clothes, while Chika checks her water-damaged phone and Mori looks at his dead phone. Keep the room sparse and the people calm but cold.
